مُرْتَكٌّ A soft, or flabby, camel, having diluted marrow (مَمْذُوقُ النِّقْىِ). (O, K. [In the CK, النَّقِىُّ is erroneously put for النِّقْىِ; and in my MS. copy of the K, النقىّ.]) ―
-b2- And A drunken man indistinct in his speech: (S:) or a man seen to be eloquent (K, TA) when alone, (TA,) but impotent in speech when he engages in altercation. (K, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
